entities.name: PMID:25092023
observations: NuAge secondary analysis in 159 generally healthy adults with T2D, mean age 75, followed for three years; diet quality measured by baseline C-HEI, physical activity by PASE change, and functional capacity by SMAF change.

Adjusted analyses reported no association of diet quality alone or diet quality combined with physical-activity change with functional-capacity decline; abstract provided no effect estimates, confidence intervals, or p-values.
Authors noted good baseline diet quality, high function, and minimal clinically nonsignificant decline as possible explanations; recommended confirmation in a larger sample.
